correctness.rationale: For any reflexive/transitive IS4 relation on C_n, forth-up and back-up are respectively monotonic row and column maxima, and transitivity forces h(h(i))=h(i), b(b(j))=b(j); both are extensive closure maps. Conversely for any closure pair the possible relation U: j<=h(i), i<=b(j) is reflexive/transitive via idempotence and contains forced generators i→h(i), b(j)→j. Their transitive closure L has exact maxima, so all transitive intermediates L⊆R⊆U are valid frames. On a chain an upward U edge is within an h-fibre and downward within a b-fibre; failure of factorization occurs iff one of the two adjacent-bit forbidden patterns. The surviving four-symbol words count 4*3^(n-2) (n≥2), with Q1=1. Independently enumerated all paired closure maps through n=5, verified L,U and uniqueness iff, counts 1,4,12,36,108; no extrapolation from n<=5.
residual_risks: Applies to reflexive transitive modal relation and both specified confluences on labeled finite chains only, not all chain binary relations or arbitrary posets.
